.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md:33-35 (#7 Verify: smallest submission; Defect: static page, single CRUD screen or mock satisfies the ask)
evidence: Greenfield build: environment/Dockerfile (byte-identical in structure to the template) leaves /app holding only .gitkeep, so the agent must write /app/server.js, the UI and the SQLite schema from nothing (integration.md: Node 22, port 3000, DB_PATH, /api/health, import once, restart persistence, fixed clock). The ask is a multi-surface product, not one screen: instruction.md asks for a secure matter-by-matter threaded chat with ethical walls and retention; walls-and-retention.md requires server-enforced walls across list/thread/search/snippets/quotes/unread/mentions/links/transcripts, live wall add/lift by a partner, 4-value per-matter timers with permanent deletion against a fixed clock, legal holds overriding timers, search, and transcripts; conversations.md requires 3+-level nested replies with quotes, edit history with stale-edit refusal, safe limited formatting, cross-matter message links with permission-aware previews, @mentions, per-user unread with a new-messages line synced across tabs, idempotent sends, consistent ordering, ~5 s live updates that keep drafts/scroll, and 390 px layout. Smallest conforming submission is therefore an authenticated Express+SQLite server with authorization on every route plus a multi-view client; the golden's 519-line server.js and 557-line app.js are consistent with that. Stub resistance in the grader: gates/render requires pre-sign-in privacy, wrong-password rejection and a populated signed-in surface (judge.toml authenticated_render); gates/constraints requires gwen's data to survive reload and excludes static mock/missing backend; functional prompt.md global gate zeroes the dimension for a 'static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade' and requires 'real task data backed by the running local server'; 17 functional criteria (total weight 35.5) include signed-out replay of the recorded message-load request, wall replays, and a real restart_app persistence leg; score.py:41-48 gives reward 0 unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05 floor (scoring.toml). Broken-app probes: (a) static page / client-only facade embedding the seed with client-side sign-in: may pass render, but has no server request to replay in signin_and_client_scope, fails the functional global gate and persistence across restart, so functional should fall to ~0 and the floor yields reward 0. (b) Single CRUD chat screen (auth + list + post, no walls/timers/holds/threads): this is already genuine build work, not a stub; it could plausibly earn ~2-5.5/35.5 functional (signin_and_client_scope, persistence, maybe nested_replies) plus polish/visual credit from rendering seed hold flags, timer label and a transcript page, so a partial reward around 0.3-0.4 is conceivable, but that is graded-partial credit for a real partial product (a reward-shaping/discrimination concern for other rows), not a stub earning the reward. Conforming alternative: any framework-free or differently structured app is acceptable; prompts say 'Do not prescribe endpoint names or implementation structure' and 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable', so a real build is not penalized for architecture. No public-requirement gap found for this row. Note: raw-evidence-index.json states reward discrimination/ranking and full configured judge runs are absent; this row's procedure (smallest-submission analysis) does not depend on them, but the weak-app score estimates above are reasoned, not measured.
